scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @goease/contracts build && concurrently --raw -k -n contracts,api,web "pnpm --filter @goease/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @goease/api dev" "pnpm --filter @goease/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @goease/contracts build && pnpm -r typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.smoke.json
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @goease/contracts build && pnpm --filter @goease/api test && pnpm --filter @goease/web test && pnpm --filter @goease/mobile test
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm --filter @goease/contracts build && pnpm --filter @goease/api build && playwright test
scripts.test: pnpm test:architecture && pnpm test:dependencies && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:deploy && pnpm test:smoke && pnpm test:dev
